intent: One monochrome plan card under a monthly/annual switch. On first view every block rises from blur, the slot-reel price spins up from zero, the total counts and the checks draw in; the thumb glides, the reels spin with motion blur and one accent marks the saving.

stack.animation: motion/react (variants with custom delays, useInView, layoutId, motion values, useVelocity, useMotionValueEvent, springs, AnimatePresence)

layout.root: @container column, max-width 420px, centred; switch 20px above the card
layout.card: #0b0b0c, radius 22px, padding 24px (28px @sm); header, price, note, seats panel, CTA, hairline, features, footnote
layout.switch: inline-grid 2 columns, 4px padding, each option min 104px x 36px
layout.seatsPanel: radius 14px, stepper row + total row split by a hairline

typography.unit: 13px ink/45, leading 1.3, two lines (split on \n), bottom aligned
typography.name: 16px 500, tracking -0.015em

color.tokens: PALETTE.dark / PALETTE.light → --pp-card, --pp-ink, --pp-on-ink, --pp-shadow, --pp-thumb-shadow, --pp-accent; no inline hex in class names
color.dark: card #0b0b0c with inset ink/8% hairline and ink/6% top highlight; ink #f4f4f5
color.light: card #ffffff with ink/8% hairline and a soft long shadow; ink #111113
color.thumb: ink fill, active label on-ink, inactive ink/55
color.accent: #7dd3a8 via the accent prop, only on the save badge: fill 12%, ring 30%, text = color-mix(accent 60%, ink) so it reads on both themes
color.cta: ink fill, on-ink text, ink/90 on hover

motion.reels: strip 0-9 x5, 1.1em cells; all reels spin up when price rises, down when it falls, from wherever they are (interruptible); spring 120/19; 55ms stagger; silent jump back to the middle copy on settle
motion.motionBlur: blur(min(2.4, |velocity in digits/s| / 9) px) on each reel
motion.digitCount: columns keyed from the right; new ones grow from width 0 over 300ms
motion.badge: spring stiffness 520, damping 20, from scale 0.6 and y 4px, origin right; exit 140ms ease-in
motion.note: cross-fade: in y 8px + blur 3px over 300ms, out y -8px over 180ms
motion.seats: count rolls 10px in the direction of change over 220ms; total tweens 450ms ease-out
motion.checks: pathLength draw 400ms, 60ms after each row lands
motion.cta: hover arrow +2px; press 0.98; loading spinner; success check draws 340ms; returns to idle after 2.6s (timer cleared on unmount)
motion.reducedMotion: one 150ms fade for every block, reels and total set instantly, no blur, checks pre-drawn
motion.entrance: once at 30% in view; T timeline (s): switch 0, card 0.06 (rise 16px from blur 8px, 600ms), header 0.12, price row 0.16, note 0.2, seats 0.24, CTA 0.28, divider draws 0.32, feature rows 0.36 + 45ms each, footnote 0.62, badge springs in 0.42
motion.countUp: before view every figure is 0: the reels are born on zero and spin up to the price (delay = price row start + 55ms per column), new columns grow from width 0, the total counts from 0 at 0.32s
motion.total: motion value written straight to the DOM (no re-render), 450ms ease-out, blur from velocity up to 1.6px

responsive.all: fluid up to 420px; price size uses cqi so it scales with the card; padding steps up at @sm
responsive.touch: stepper buttons and switch options keep 44px-equivalent targets

accessibility: billing switch is a radiogroup with roving tabindex and arrow keys
visual price aria-hidden; sr-only sentence with price, unit and note
polite live region summarising billing, seats and total
stepper is a labelled group; buttons labelled 'Add a seat' / 'Remove a seat' and disabled at limits
CTA aria-busy while loading plus a status message

content.plan: Team: For product teams who write things down and can find them again.
features: Unlimited docs, with full version history
Free guests, with access set page by page
Support from people who use it daily
content.cta: Start 14-day trial / Setting up your trial… / Check your inbox
content.footnote: Prices in USD. Tax added at checkout.

avoid: a three-plan section or marketing headline
digits that cross-fade instead of rolling
layout shift when the total or unit changes
mint or any accent on the checks
per-frame React state for counting figures
blocks that pop in without the staggered blur rise
